verified: In exact rmcp-v3.1.4 source, SubscriptionSink::send explicitly rejects ServerNotification::TaskStatusNotification with UnsupportedNotification("notifications/tasks"). The source comment says SEP-2663 task status notifications are not yet routable through subscriptions/listen because SubscriptionFilter has no taskIds field and clients currently observe task state by polling tasks/get. This rejection occurs before the later metadata mutation and peer.send_notification call used for supported subscription notifications.
